about.title: I build web products end to end
about.text: I'm a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years designing and shipping scalable web applications, from the API to the frontend in production. I've been the technical lead on solutions for Movistar, Claro and Telefónica, and today I build enterprise compliance and applied AI platforms.

intro.title: Hi, I'm Juan David Vásquez
intro.role: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer · Cloud & AI Solutions
intro.text: For more than 8 years I've been designing and shipping scalable web applications, from the API to the frontend in production. I've been the technical lead on enterprise solutions for Movistar, Claro and Telefónica, and today I build enterprise compliance (AML and due diligence) and applied AI platforms.

beyond.title: Beyond code
beyond.text: I'm the co-founder and sole developer of OneLessonPerDay, a social impact platform that connects animal shelters with adopters. It centralizes shelter management: the adoption process, vet appointments, deworming alerts and an interactive map of Colombia by department and municipality.
